info.title: Mercaria public API
info.description: Read-only commerce data for other Oxy applications: products, stores and collections. Success bodies are the value itself; every error is `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }`. Lists are `{ items, nextCursor }` and end at 10000 items. Generated from `@mercaria/contracts`; `@mercaria.co/sdk` is the supported client.

get.description: A published collection of a live store.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The entity id. A malformed id answers 404, not 400.

400.description: `bad_request`: Malformed: a wrong type, a missing field, an unknown or repeated parameter, or a cursor from another list.

404.description: `not_found`: The entity never existed, or the id is malformed.

410.description: `gone`: The entity existed and is no longer publicly available. Says nothing about why.

429.description: `rate_limited`: Rate limit hit. `details.retryAfterSeconds` and `Retry-After` say when to retry.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the caller may retry.

get.description: Every publicly live product, optionally scoped to one store or collection. A `storeId` or `collectionId` naming an entity that is not public answers 404 or 410, never an empty page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–50. Default 20.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page’s `nextCursor`, verbatim, with the same filters.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text query, 1–200 characters after trimming.

parameters.name: inStock
parameters.description: `true` keeps products that can be bought now; `false` filters nothing.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ordering. Default `relevance` with `q`, `newest` without; `relevance` requires `q`.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: A BCP 47 tag whose translations are ALSO searched. No effect without `q`.

parameters.name: storeId
parameters.description: Only this store’s products. A gone store answers 410.

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Only this collection’s products. A gone collection answers 410.

message.description: Human-readable and safe to log. Never parse it.

details.description: Scalars only. `rate_limited` carries `retryAfterSeconds`; request errors carry `field`.

alt.description: Accessible description, or null when the seller gave none.

amount.description: Integer minor units (cents for EUR, yen for JPY).

MercariaMoney.description: A price in the listing’s native currency.

primaryImage.description: The first gallery image, or null.

compareAtPrice.description: The cheapest option’s pre-discount price when on sale.

priceRange.description: The span across purchase options, or null when they all cost the same.
